;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Aftermath of the [[Sudanese Revolution]]
**The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] says it has quelled a [[mutiny]] by soldiers loyal to ousted [[President of Sudan|President]] [[Omar al-Bashir]] in the capital [[Khartoum]]. Former Director of the [[National Intelligence and Security Service (Sudan)|National Intelligence and Security Service]] [[Salah Gosh]] is accused of orchestrating the mutiny, which left two troops dead. His current whereabouts are unknown. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-51112518 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Holy See|Vatican]] appoints [[Francesca Di Giovanni]] undersecretary for multilateral affairs in the [[Secretariat of State (Holy See)|Secretariat of State]], the first woman to hold a management position in this office. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51124478 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[January 2020 North American storm complex|Winter Storm Jacob]] makes landfall over the [[Pacific Northwest]], bringing high winds and up to {{convert|22|in|cm}} of snow to the [[Olympic Peninsula]] and forcing widespread road closures and transport cancellations. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-12-mid-january-snow-ice-rain-storm-west-midwest-northeast (The Weather Channel)]

;International relations
*[[Egypt–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkey]] summons its ''[[chargé d'affaires]]'' to [[Egypt]] after accusing the [[State Security Investigations Service|Egyptian security forces]] of raiding the [[Cairo]] offices of the state-run [[Anadolu Agency|Anadolu News Agency]] and arresting four of its employees. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security/turkey-says-egyptian-security-forces-raid-news-agency-in-cairo-idUSKBN1ZE1U5?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**North Korean state media condemn [[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] for his attempts to reform the [[Article 9 of the Japanese Constitution|pacifist]] [[Constitution of Japan|Japanese constitution]]. The state media say that "in the event of a constitutional revision, which gives [Japan's] [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|self-defense forces]] legitimacy, the Japanese reactionaries will have all the preconditions necessary to realize military aggression overseas". [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/01/15/North-Korea-rails-against-Japan-plans-for-constitutional-amendment/6591579104508/ (United Press International)]
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**In a meeting at the [[White House]], [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Vice Premier of China|Chinese Vice Premier]] [[Liu He (politician)|Liu He]] sign "Phase 1"  of a new trade deal in which the U.S. will relax some of the tariffs imposed on Chinese imports while China agreed to buy more American products. Both sides also agree to not impose new tariffs. [https://www.npr.org/2020/01/15/796305300/trump-to-sign-phase-one-china-trade-deal-but-most-tariffs-remain-in-place (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*The [[Government of Russia|Russian government]] of [[Dmitry Medvedev's Second Cabinet]] [[Resignation of Russian government|resigns]] after [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] delivers the [[Presidential Address to the Federal Assembly]], in which he proposed several amendments to the constitution. Putin accepts the resignation. [[Dmitry Medvedev|Medvedev]] says the constitutional changes would "significantly change Russia's balance of power". [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/dmitry-medvedev-resign-russia-prime-minister-putin-quit-latest-a9284741.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-51120166 (BBC News)]
*[[Greece|Greek]] [[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] nominates [[Council of State (Greece)|Council of State]] president [[Aikaterini Sakellaropoulou]] to be [[President of Greece]]. If approved, she will be the first female president in Greek history. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-politics-president/greek-pm-taps-top-female-judge-as-countrys-president-idUSKBN1ZE2FE?il=0 (Reuters)]
*The [[Virginia]] [[Virginia House of Delegates|House of Delegates]] votes to ratify the [[Equal Rights Amendment]] decades after its deadline passed. As the amendment nonetheless now has enough [[U.S. state|states]] for it to be fully adopted, legal scholars are divided on whether this means the [[Constitution of the United States]] has been amended. [https://www.npr.org/2020/01/15/796754345/virginia-ratifies-the-equal-rights-amendment-decades-after-deadline (NPR)]
